generator.background: Two holes at (3*row+phase) mod10 and the following column mod10; phase=(3*firstRow+column) mod10.
generator.wells: Override background in each three-row well. Top has one hole: column+1 in early well, column+2 in late well. Bottom has holes column,column+1,column+2. Middle has column,column+2 when aligned, otherwise column+1,column+2. Exactly one aligned well per arm.
generator.encoding: Unchanged encodeDecision52 + actionOutcome22 and encodeFootprints. Constructor/arm/family/quality labels never enter features. 24/74 are diagnostic projections only, not new model inputs.

reference.implementation: NEW_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; existing pointReference rejects this two-MIEUM domain
reference.traversal: Full ordered legal tree once per state; retain the best terminal evaluation conditional on EACH root, without memoization or production pruning.
reference.evaluator: Existing evaluateState/compareEvaluations lexicographic order and current 19-piece catalog, unchanged.
reference.terminal: Stop only at no remaining pieces or gameover. No next supply, reroll, items, reacquisition, random future or early stopping at next-playing.
reference.rewards: Accumulate actual clearedRows and acquiredItems along each path before terminal evaluateState; no new score or partial-depth terminal fallback.
reference.incomplete: Retain partial report; STOP, no reference labels or baseline-success verdict; no retry, quota refill, tuning or extra samples.
reference.qualityTargets: All root indices whose complete conditional best terminal evaluation equals the complete global best by compareEvaluations. Single-label representative is first ordered quality member, auxiliary only; existing labels unchanged.

gates.structure: All 32 planned states: initial point-only legal list of32, no items or full rows; exactly two immediate1-row clears and all others0; legal order and inputs immutable.
gates.primary: 16 late-aligned states: complete reference, all-pieces-placed terminal exists, immediate-clear-tied candidates have different best quality and first-legal immediate baseline is outside the quality set.
gates.control: 16 early-aligned states: same complete and salvageability checks, fixed immediate baseline is inside the quality set. Report the worse tied immediate action too.
gates.pairing: Each family has two different boards, matching metadata and exact ordered FP32 outcome22 matrices, equal root count, disjoint nonempty quality-target index sets. Expected two unique point-clear roots; reference must establish them, never overwrite labels from geometry.
gates.representation: Audit ordered22 identity and quality-set information bound; report22/24/74 and board-plane distinctions separately. Board-aware CNN is not restricted to22 and no model is executed.
gates.novelty: Require32 distinct board/D2 groups and no board/D2 overlap with prior train-dev, fit16, transfer144 and coverage64. Report FP32 target/row/tagged-multiset overlap and cross-family duplicates, not independent generalization or a new training split.
gates.holdoutBoundary: Original held-out archive access0; no model fitting or evaluation split created. Counterfactual arm pairs stay in one family in any separately approved future split.
gates.quotas: Any incomplete/structure/pair/primary/control/novelty/repeat mismatch fails this fixed campaign; retain every attempted descriptor and rejection. No resampling, split reassignment or replacement.

stage.next: Separate user decision required for new diagnostic states, reference and quality targets. Generator/runner/execution config not implemented.
stage.following: Any model, feature, loss, training, test, RL, app adoption or publication is a separate decision; no learning budget here.
